evidence.quote: I expect that an additional rate increase of 75 basis points will be appropriate at our next meeting as well as increases of at least 50 basis points in the next few subsequent meetings
Inflation is the highest we have seen in the United States in 40 years and so far it shows little sign of moderating.
the labor market is extremely tight, as indicated by a variety of measures
But in my view, our number one responsibility is to reduce inflation.
it would make sense to eventually incorporate MBS sales into the plan so that reaching this goal does not take too long.
I am therefore committed to a policy that will bring the real federal funds rate back into positive territory.
